color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
1 · Foothold
Windows: code execution in a web application, inside its IIS application pool
Here: one application pod (assumed)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
2 · Credential harvesting
Windows: web.config, machine keys, the pool identity's token, then LSASS and tickets
Here: no API token mounted, metadata service unreachable, only the pod's own short-lived token

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
3 · Lateral movement
Windows: the other pools on the server, pass-the-hash to the next server, ride a trust
Here: default deny by identity in the zone; NSG + Firewall + Cilium between zones; no path between cells

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
4 · Privilege escalation
Windows: pool identity → SYSTEM (SeImpersonate 'Potato'), Kerberoasting, ACL abuse, AD CS
Here: restricted pod security refuses privileged / host access; pods cannot reach the API server

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
5 · Dominance
Windows: DCSync, golden ticket
Here: cluster admin = one cell, only through PIM break-glass or a Kubernetes vulnerability

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
6 · Persistence
Windows: web shell, IIS module, GPO, SYSVOL, scheduled tasks
Here: nodes replaced, pods restart from signed images, Flux reverts – persistence moves to Git and the registry
